findings.summary: Amitay Weiss filed HFIA-triggered Form 3 simultaneously at four Nasdaq-listed Israeli micro-caps: ParaZero (PRZO), SciSparc (SPRC), Maris Tech (MTEK), and Jeffs' Brands (JFBR) — all on the same date using accession-prefix 0001213900 (Toppan Merrill), indicating coordinated batch compliance filing.
findings.detail: ParaZero accession 0001213900-26-029463; SciSparc accession 0001213900-26-030644; Maris Tech accession 0001213900-26-030812; Jeffs' Brands accession 0001213900-26-031244. All four use the same 0001213900 EDGAR filer prefix (Toppan Merrill), suggesting the filings were processed as a coordinated batch through a single compliance agent.

findings.summary: Amitay Weiss holds positions at a minimum of 10 Israeli micro-cap Nasdaq/OTC issuers — exceeding the 9 named in the original lead. EDGAR full-text search returns 460 document hits across SciSparc (82), Clearmind (65), Maris Tech (44), ParaZero (43), Jeffs' Brands (41), Viewbix (24), Charging Robotics/Fuel Doctor (24), N2OFF/Save Foods/Nexentis (23+), Rail Vision (10), and Laminera (7).

findings.summary: Three individuals — Moshe Revach, Oz Adler, and Tali Dinar — each serve simultaneously on the boards of multiple Weiss-cluster companies, constituting a tight network of cross-directors underpinning the cluster.
findings.detail: Moshe Revach (CIK 0001973293): Form 3 filed at ParaZero (0001213900-26-029459), SciSparc (0001213900-26-030649), Jeffs' Brands (0001213900-26-031236) on 2026-03-18. Shares address 7 Mezada St., Bnei Brak with Weiss at Jeffs' Brands. Oz Adler (CIK 0001973096): Form 3 at SciSparc, Jeffs' Brands, Rail Vision, Polyrizon on 2026-03-18; also appears in Oct 2025 SciSparc/N2OFF joint filing. Tali Dinar (CIK 0001574875): Form 3 at ParaZero, Jeffs' Brands; long Nasdaq career including Micronet Enertec Technologies (2013–2018).

findings.summary: The four HFIA Form 3 filings by Weiss were processed through the same EDGAR agent (Toppan Merrill, prefix 0001213900) on the same day, suggesting a single compliance counsel or administrator manages Section 16 obligations across the entire portfolio — a further indicator of coordinated governance.

Chairman Amitay Weiss simultaneously chairs or sits on boards of at least 9 other companies (SciSparc SPRC, Maris-Tech MTEK, Nexentis NXTS, Charging Robotics CHEV, Jeff Brands JFBR, Clearmind CMND, Viewbix VBIX, Soltera, Tomer Ltd) while serving as CEO of Tzemach Investment House Ltd.
findings.detail: Per 20-F Item 6A. The cluster of companies is predominantly Israeli micro-caps listed on Nasdaq or OTC. Tali Dinar (ParaZero director) is also CFO of Charging Robotics where Weiss is Chairman. Moshe Revach (ParaZero director) also sits on SciSparc and Jeff Brands boards with Weiss. This is a tightly interlocked governance cluster.

connections.description: Amitay Weiss serves as Chairman of both ParaZero Technologies and Maris-Tech Ltd. (MTEK), another defense-adjacent Israeli micro-cap in the HFIA universe. Same individual chairing two HFIA targets simultaneously.

Tali Dinar was CFO of Xylo Technologies (ParaZero's former parent) while simultaneously serving as ParaZero director. She is now CFO of Charging Robotics, where Weiss is chairman. Creates a three-entity overlap: ParaZero — Xylo Technologies — Charging Robotics.

Moshe Revach serves as director at ParaZero, SciSparc, and Jeff Brands — all three companies where Amitay Weiss also serves on the board. Co-directorship across multiple micro-cap Nasdaq Israeli companies.

Amitay Weiss and Moshe Revach share the same address (7 Mezada Street, Bnei Brak) in their Jeffs' Brands Form 3 filings, and both serve simultaneously on three of the same boards (ParaZero, SciSparc, Jeffs' Brands). Revach likely serves as Weiss's operational co-director or proxy across the portfolio.

Oz Adler serves simultaneously on the boards of two Weiss portfolio companies (SciSparc, Jeffs' Brands) and two adjacent cluster companies (Rail Vision, Polyrizon). His presence at four Nasdaq issuers in the same HFIA filing wave suggests active coordination with or at the direction of the Weiss governance cluster.
Weiss chairs both SciSparc (acquiring company) and AutoMax Motors Ltd. (acquisition target) simultaneously during active merger. SciSparc F-1 filed Aug 2024. No independent fairness opinion obtained.

N2OFF/Nexentis Technologies (CIK 0001789192) has undergone three name changes: Save Foods → N2OFF → Nexentis. Weiss was Chairman of Save Foods since August 2020 and remains Director as of March 2026. Corporate transformation may have changed governance structure.
